candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on Thai script characters and words, as well as terms related to calendars, household management, and travel.
This feature vector represents common prepositions and possessive particles across multiple languages, particularly Thai and Romance languages.
This feature vector is related to common Thai words, syllables, and text fragments.
This vector activates for the Thai consonant letter 'ม' (Mo Ma) across various tonal marks and contextual pairings.
This vector represents Thai character sequences ending with the consonant ว (Wo Waen).
This feature vector is related to Thai script characters, syllables, and phonetic sub-word tokens.
The tokens are letters of the Thai alphabet.
This feature vector activates on rare, fragmented, or out-of-vocabulary multilingual subwords and character sequences.
This vector activates for subword tokens commonly found in Thai script and specific capitalized proper noun prefixes.
This vector is related to sub-word text fragments and linguistic prefixes.
